_doc: Icon Kit glyphs: the central picture of an icon. js/iconkit.js iconFor() scores every row against a spell: a tag word in the spell's name, its element and its mechanic (data/glyphs.json `mechanics`). `file` = the best art there is (a painted 256 px WebP once tools/import-layers.py has run, else the SVG placeholder), `small` = the 64 px WebP for buttons up to 48 px, `placeholder` = the drawn SVG (always kept). `tintable` glyphs are drawn in light greys and take the spell's element colour, so one drawing serves every element. element '' = any element. `artElement` = the colour a painted generic glyph was painted in: a spell of another element gets the drawn tintable version instead. `placeholder` may point at another glyph's drawing while a new glyph waits for paint.

mechanics.strike: Melee swing or cone in front
mechanics.area: Circle on the ground at range
mechanics.leap: Jump to a spot and land hard
mechanics.summon: Calls a pet, totem or minion
mechanics.dot: Poison, curse or harm over time
